LCD connector reference models

Purpose: assembly illustrations for the 24-position LCD cable connector pair.
Nominal dimensions and compatible-part references are listed in ../sources.json.
Internal moulding, springs, hooks and clearances include estimates.

Editable dimensions are in parameters.json. The analytic model recipe is
build_models.py. It uses Python, NumPy and the OpenCascade Python bindings (OCP).
From the project root:

python dist/cable-assembly/native/models/source/build_models.py --output rebuilt

The output is two indexed GLB models and their matching triangle-material table.
GLB positions are in metres; model parameters and reference datums are in mm.
Use each model with the material table generated by the same recipe.
